source_policy: Selected DOCX alone supplies employment history; answer bank supplies separately attested personal facts only.
employer_default: No for direct prior employment at companies absent from the complete resume history; ambiguous aliases or contractor/affiliate questions require review.
other_answers: Use supported current user facts or saved answer bank; unresolved or contradictory fields are NEEDS_MIKE.
resume_changes: Stop source-dependent work and re-extract/review changed resume; never silently update hashes.
